description:
Universe Simulator is an interactive universe sandbox: a full-screen living universe where you play god. Tap to birth a star, drag to tear open a black hole (it pulls nearby stars into orbit and swallows the ones that fall in), detonate a supernova into a nebula, or spin up a whole spiral galaxy. Presets: Big Bang, Milky Way, Black Hole, Nebula. Controls for time speed, gravity, star count and a scale slider that zooms from quantum foam out to galaxy clusters; a Quantum field toggle reveals flowing wave lines beneath everything, a nod to Faggin's quantum-field view of the universe.

A playful simulation, not real astrophysics: gravity and orbits are simplified for fun (a softened inverse-square law, invented drag, stars wrapping at the edges), and the displayed entropy is a game quantity built from spread and burnouts, not a thermodynamic measurement. The quantum-field view is a visual motif, not a measurement.
title: Universe Simulator
